“At the Pentagon, ‘Hegseth did not want to hear the word Ukraine,’ a senior Ukrainian official told me of that period.”

The overwhelming lesson to US commanders from Russian war so far has been the innovation of Ukrainian forces. It’s all anyone talks about. But Hegseth and his guys absolutely refuse to accept the idea that we have anything to learn from others.

As the leader of Army European Command, General Donahue implemented the Ukrainian anti-Shahed interceptors and issued reports to encourage their deployment in Middle East. He was ignored. And then he was fired by Hegseth.

“The Pentagon ignored their warnings, which included detailed reports sent up the chain of command. Several of the officers who tried to raise the alarm about Iranian Shaheds have since been fired or forced into early retirement.”
